name_input: M/S BIKANERVALA FOODS PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S BIKANERVALA FOODS P.LTD.; BIKANERVALA FOOD PRIVATE LIMITED; BIKANERVALA FOODS PVT . LTD; BIKANERVALA FOODS PRIVATE LIMITED
court_cases: Multiple civil/commercial matters in Delhi High Court, all trademark/arbitration/petition type, no criminal matters found. Company appears in BOTH roles. (1) Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd vs Ministry of Textiles & Anr., Delhi HC, order 27.04.2011, W.P.(C) 5860/2010 — company as PETITIONER, status: order passed (2011). (2) M/s Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd vs DCIT, ITAT Delhi, order 06.06.2019, ITA 6357/Del/2015, AY 2011-12 — company as APPELLANT in income-tax appeal, status: decided 2019. (3) Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd vs M/s Namaste Foods & Ors., Delhi HC, O.M.P.(T)(COMM.) 22/2024, order 14.03.2024 — PETITIONER, arbitration petition. (4) Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd vs M/s Saatvik Foods & Ors., Delhi HC, ARB.P. 1106/2022, orders 20.10.2022 and 16.01.2023 — PETITIONER. (5) Saatvik Foods & Ors vs Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd, Delhi HC, order 16.07.2024 — RESPONDENT. (6) Shree Shyam Snacks Food Pvt Ltd vs Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd, Delhi HC, order 09.01.2024 — DEFENDANT. (7) Anandam Sweets Private Limited vs Bikanervala Foods Private Limited, Delhi HC, orders 03.11.2026 and 16.10.2026 — DEFENDANT (trademark/passing-off). (8) Ank Restobars Pvt Ltd vs Bikanervala Foods Pvt Ltd, Delhi HC, order 27.04.2016 — RESPONDENT. Source: indiankanoon.org search 'Bikanervala Foods' (121 documents total, first 10 reviewed). All are ordinary commercial/IP disputes; per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds.
news_risk: No adverse regulatory action or negative news found in the sources reachable. Note: DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable during this check (connection refused), so news coverage could not be swept systematically — absence of findings here is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. Company website (bikanervala.com) shows an active multi-country retail/restaurant footprint (India, Nepal, UAE, USA, UK, Singapore, Qatar, Canada, Bahrain, Australia, New Zealand) — commercial presence only, not a risk finding.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'Bikanervala Russia' returned zero matching results. Company's own published outlet list (bikanervala.com) covers India, Nepal, UAE, USA, UK, Singapore, Qatar, Canada, Bahrain, Australia, New Zealand — no Russia/CIS/Belarus presence listed. No customs, B-L or contract record evidencing RF/CIS supply was located. Status: not confirmed, not alleged.
note: Risk-only scope. Sanctions: OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List could not be positively cleared — the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool requires JavaScript and the bulk SDN CSV download truncated at the 6,000-character fetch limit, so no name match was actually executed. sanctions_hit is therefore null (NOT a confirmed negative). Recommend a manual OFAC/EU/UK consolidated-list name screen before onboarding. Court record is substantial but entirely civil/commercial (trademark, arbitration, income-tax) — neutral per rule 2, not a rejection ground. Credit rating: not public — the company is unlisted (BSE lookup returned no listed security) and no CRISIL/India Ratings/CARE/ICRA press release was retrievable; rating set to null rather than inferred. No regulator action or negative news located, but the web_search tool was down for the whole session, so news coverage is incomplete and should be re-run. No RF/CIS supply evidence. Overall: no rejection trigger identified, but sanctions screening and news sweep are outstanding and must be completed before a final verdict.
